_comment: ACP Wall registry entry schema. Copy this file to <your-harness>.json. All fields except `name` and `run` are optional but `install`+`version` are strongly recommended so CI probes a pinned release.
name: example-agent

env._comment_env: env vars set on the agent process. ${MOCK_LLM_URL} is replaced with the probe's mock LLM base URL (OpenAI-compatible /v1). Wire whichever var makes the harness talk to it.

_comment_sessionFiles: optional: files written into the probe's temp session workspace before session/new (agent also spawns there). ${MOCK_LLM_URL} and ${REPO_ROOT} are substituted. Use for harness config — e.g. pin the provider at the mock LLM, or set an ask permission policy so session/request_permission is exercised.
notes: anything reviewers should know — e.g. 'requires OAuth, prompt probes will be unverified'
